candidates.name: Blue Open-Knit Sleeveless Polo
candidates.decisionReason: The original proves a breathable dusty-blue open knit, clean collar and controlled regular-relaxed body. It is a credible warm-weather product, but using it with the only viable light-blue trouser would make this core too tonally blue; keep it unique and available for a later Summer Resort or Date look.

candidates.name: Apricot Zip-Neck Knit Tank
candidates.decisionReason: The sleeveless knit is seasonally credible, but its squared shoulder, broad body and long low-hip hem create an overly loose block. The near-cream color also provides too little color contrast for the requested happier Summer Casual look.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Band-Collar Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The shirt is visibly dropped through the shoulder, long in the sleeve and worn open over a second top. It is a useful mild-weather overshirt, not a self-contained hot-summer top, and would repeat the loose layered styling being removed.

candidates.name: Brown Short-Sleeve Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Only a hanger view is available, so shoulder, chest, body length and sleeve proportion cannot be verified. The staged white tee is not part of the product; the shirt cannot be approved as a Mid-Range core without on-body fit proof.

candidates.name: French-Blue Short-Sleeve Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The dropped shoulder, very wide chest and long rounded hem make this a deliberately oversized open layer dependent on a separate white tee. Its blue-gray tone is also darker than the brighter, self-contained Summer core required here.

candidates.name: Cream-Caramel Openwork Polo
candidates.decisionReason: Original review confirms a breathable cream openwork knit, caramel stripe, clean camp collar, controlled regular ease and an upper-hip hem. The texture and warm graphic line give the core modern Zara character without a skinny chest, oversized body or dark palette.

candidates.name: Gum-Leaf Roll-Sleeve Henley
candidates.decisionReason: The mint color is useful, but the roll-sleeve Henley has a long tunic-like body and broad loose chest. Its generic beach-shirt presentation lacks the controlled proportion and polished Zara finish needed for this Mid-Range everyday core.

candidates.name: White Textured Notch-Neck Tank
candidates.decisionReason: The original shows deep open armholes, a broad loose body and cheap gym-street styling with camo trousers. It does not read polished Mid-Range Casual Everyday and would recreate the oversized top problem.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Toile Tailored Short
candidates.decisionReason: The botanical toile is visually credible and the leg is controlled, but the knee-length printed short reads destination Resort more than everyday city Casual. It would also compete with the openwork polo stripe, so keep it unique for a later solid-top vacation outfit.

candidates.name: Sage Clean Zip-Detail Short
candidates.decisionReason: The source is product-only and gives no body fit proof. Its integrated web belt, two zip pockets and curved technical thigh seams make it an outdoor/performance short rather than a clean Mid-Range everyday bottom.

candidates.name: Navy Clean Summer Short
candidates.decisionReason: The navy short reaches the knee and uses sharp center creases with a narrow conventional line. It looks dated and business-casual rather than current Zara, while the dark navy would mute the happier Summer palette.

candidates.name: Khaki Clean Summer Short
candidates.decisionReason: The warm striped fabric could work, but only a flat product image is available. Rise, thigh ease and actual on-body length are unproven, so it cannot be the visually approved core bottom.

candidates.name: Pastel-Blue Chino Short
candidates.decisionReason: The saturated pastel-blue chino is product-only, with elasticated side panels, rolled cuffs and a slightly shiny finish. There is no proof of a modern thigh or hem proportion, and the styling reads generic rather than refined.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The original proves an airy light-blue straight leg with controlled thigh ease, a clean ankle crop and no hem stacking. Its relaxed waist is summer-appropriate while the unpuddled line balances the patterned polo and keeps the whole look light.

candidates.name: Tan Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The tan trouser is visibly broad from hip to hem and pools over both shoes, with a prominent long drawstring. It is exactly the baggy, puddled lower-half silhouette this rebuild must remove.

candidates.name: Army-Green Ribbed Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The ribbed army-green trouser is seasonally wearable, but its elastic lounge waist, full wide leg and dark saturated color push it toward Resort/lounge styling. It is too visually heavy for this bright Mid-Range everyday core.
